<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation and Policy:</strong> India&#x27;s retail inflation rose to 4.38% in June, crossing the RBI’s 4% midpoint target for the first time in 17 months, while the central bank maintained the repo rate and projected a 6.9% real GDP growth for the current fiscal.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>New Derivatives:</strong> The NSE received SEBI approval to launch futures and options on the Nifty India FPI 150 Index starting August 12, expanding the range of available hedging instruments.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxOWHZ2TWVqRUFTSDdyd0gyNXBaOXR0Q3NfX0FhWjVvLVpyZ1pWN0t4VnAyRHlqRkEzcGI2VTZibkF1dlhKVVRhSm5HUUpKQW9LZUQxdHlkTl9YODUzSjEwR1BZdEtYY2hvajdHMVRvTU4zVm13VEYwczhtSXE3M0JGeHM3NUJIVHhHNnlKRDRmS0xueXR1RFFUNTFaNHhaY1dzaTFnVjVhUkYzbTF3ZWZxWG9wWmgzUTdTZmRLTXVWNFRMU0xzb0Nz?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Sentiment:</strong> Indian equity markets ended flat as profit booking and geopolitical tensions in West Asia offset earlier gains driven by IT sector performance and softer US inflation data.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W19</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and Commodities:</strong> The rupee remains under pressure due to lower-than-expected FCNR(B) inflows, while global crude oil prices hovering near $85 per barrel continue to influence market volatility.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxNNWxiRkZzY2xvQnUtc3FOMWV4Skg0VXJBN08tNG1HUkNMLVdRUDB3MnJVZFgwc09ta0dZR09OcTdwWkdvQVR0LUpYbGtTWWpXWWY4SzU4bWEwaUhtMFgzZ29Tb0pYZVZLYThhajQwMEp2VmJZNUNqS1o3MUZQTElndmc4UUlTRjZDaVdZYmdkSmtoeG9LZkRqMlVhLVZpd05JXzlhWHI1WExyN1JfalByWGtod09vaEdwSDRhS0h4d0lkYVdvempfSEln?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a></span></li>
